title: Planning to Learn: Real-Time Robust Adaptive Control on the GPU with Guaranteed Future Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.20925v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Robust adaptive control is vital for keeping robots safe while actively reducing uncertainty in unfamiliar settings. However, traditional methods are often conservative since they fail to account for guaranteed future parameter learning during planning and struggle to scale to high-dimensional systems. In this work, we present A-SLS, a learning-aware robust adaptive model predictive control (RAMPC) framework based on system-level synthesis. A-SLS forecasts future parameter uncertainty and preserves correlations between process disturbances, parameter error, and estimate updates to construct tight, guaranteed reachable sets that account for future information gain. We also develop a GPU-accelerated A-SLS solver to enable real-time performance. Across nonlinear robotic systems, A-SLS reduces reachable-tube conservativeness, maintains real-time performance, and scales to whole-body control for a quadruped with 61 states, 8 uncertain param

translated_title: 规划以学习：基于GPU的具有未来学习保证的实时鲁棒自适应控制
translated_abstract: 鲁棒自适应控制对于在陌生环境中主动降低不确定性、保障机器人安全至关重要。然而，传统方法往往过于保守，因为它们在规划时未能考虑有保证的未来参数学习，并且难以扩展到高维系统。在这项工作中，我们提出了A-SLS，这是一个基于系统级综合的学习感知鲁棒自适应模型预测控制（RAMPC）框架。A-SLS预测未来的参数不确定性，并保留过程扰动、参数误差和估计更新之间的相关性，从而构建考虑未来信息增益的紧凑且有保证的可达集。我们还开发了GPU加速的A-SLS求解器以实现实时性能。在多个非线性机器人系统上，A-SLS降低了可达管的保守性，保持了实时性能，并可扩展到具有61个状态、8个不确定参数的四足机器人全身控制。
tldr: 提出A-SLS框架，通过预测未来参数不确定性并构建考虑未来信息增益的紧致可达集，结合GPU加速求解器，实现了具有未来学习保证的实时鲁棒自适应控制，并可扩展至四足机器人全身控制。
